definition: to chase something and not give up
description: On a windy heather moor under a cloudy sky, a young woman with a long braid, in a red jacket and dark trousers, runs with one shoe off, reaching after a red round flying device with a small box hanging under it, while a black and white sheepdog races beside her. A startled grouse flaps away from her feet. The device rises out of reach, and she jumps and stretches her arms up after it as the dog leaps too. A lost boot, a hat and a map lie in the heather, and a man on a quad bike watches from a dirt track.

de.answer: Sie jagt einem davonfliegenden Ballon nach.
